subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

**Reverent**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Respectful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Reverent"** means showing deep respect or admiration for someone or something. (श्रद्धालु, आदरयुक्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The students were reverent during the teacher's speech, showing their utmost respect.
 
 
 
• **"Respectful"** means treating someone or something with consideration, honor, or admiration. (सम्मानजनक)
 
 
• **Example:** He was respectful towards his elders and always sought their blessings before making any major decision.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **"Reverent"** is **"Respectful"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Respectful**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rushed** (जल्दबाजी में): Acting or done with excessive haste.

 
 
• **Example:** The rushed preparation for the event led to several mistakes.
 
 
 
• **Important** (महत्वपूर्ण): Of great significance or value.
 
 
• **Example:** It is important to stay hydrated during the summer months.
 
 
 
• **Related** (संबंधित): Connected or associated with something.
 
 
• **Example:** The documents related to the project were reviewed by the manager.
 
 

14e:T85c,

The correct answer is** option 4.**
